heap_or_limit: Druid Router DRUID_XMS=1g and DRUID_XMX=1g; Docker HostConfig.Memory=0, no container memory limit

utilization_conditions.summary: 默认未启用认证的 Druid Router Avatica protobuf endpoint 可由匿名客户端用大型合法 protobuf POST 触发 Router JVM heap OOM；1GiB Router heap 复测中，128MiB 请求后 Router 仍运行，256MiB 请求导致 Java heap OOM、Router exit 3 和 HTTP health connection refused。
limits_or_mitigations: HTTP request body size limit or reverse proxy limit below the OOM threshold
Network isolation of Router or JDBC endpoint
Rate limiting or per-client quota on large POST bodies
Higher Router heap may raise the threshold but does not remove the unbounded full-body buffering behavior
not_affected_when: Router is not exposed to low-trust clients
Avatica protobuf endpoint is blocked or protected by authentication
A front proxy or server setting rejects large request bodies before they reach Router
Druid deployment does not route JDBC/Avatica traffic through Router

commands: docker compose -p druid_avatica_case -f docker-compose.yml up -d postgres zookeeper coordinator broker router
config_changes: Harness removed fixed container_name values to avoid collisions with other workers.
Harness bound host ports to 127.0.0.1 and shifted host port numbers for isolation.
Harness started the Router/Broker/Coordinator/PostgreSQL/ZooKeeper subset required for this Router-to-Broker Avatica path.
No Druid endpoint, body limit, authentication, heap, or Router/Broker runtime property was changed to enable the issue.

trigger.request_shape: HTTP POST to Router /druid/v2/sql/avatica-protobuf/ with Content-Type application/x-protobuf; body is a valid Avatica OpenConnectionRequest plus protobuf unknown length-delimited padding.

parameters.padding_field: protobuf unknown field 2047, wire type length-delimited

trigger.bandwidth_notes: Single-threaded local HTTP probe; 128MiB reached the Router while it stayed running, and 256MiB caused Router exit with Java heap OOM under DRUID_XMX=1g.
